note: Curated MCP servers. `ax mcp add <name>` appends the entry to bot.toml; remote servers default to OAuth and never store secrets.

servers.name: github
servers.description: Repos, issues, pull requests, Actions and code search.
servers.needs: set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN; edit bot.toml to auth = "oauth" to log in with a browser instead

servers.name: gitlab
servers.description: Projects, merge requests, issues and pipelines.

servers.name: notion
servers.description: Search and edit pages and databases.

servers.name: figma
servers.description: Read design files and export assets.

servers.name: supabase
servers.description: Query projects, tables and edge functions.

servers.name: slack
servers.description: Search channels, read threads and post messages.

servers.name: neon
servers.description: Postgres branches, SQL and project management.

servers.name: posthog
servers.description: Product analytics, SQL, feature flags and experiments.

servers.name: intercom
servers.description: Support conversations, contacts and help center.

servers.name: hubspot
servers.description: CRM contacts, companies, deals and tickets.

servers.name: attio
servers.description: CRM records, lists, notes and tasks.

servers.name: gamma
servers.description: Generate presentations, documents and web pages.

servers.name: framer
servers.description: Edit Framer sites, pages and CMS content.

servers.name: zoom
servers.needs: create a Zoom app and set ZOOM_CLIENT_ID (and ZOOM_CLIENT_SECRET unless it is a public client)

servers.name: gusto
servers.description: Payroll, employees, contractors and time off.

servers.name: hunter
servers.description: Find and verify emails, discover companies.

servers.name: playwright
servers.description: Drive a real browser: navigate, click, screenshot, test.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Read and write files under one directory.
servers.needs: pass the workspace directory: ax mcp add filesystem --arg /path/to/workspace

servers.name: fetch
servers.description: Fetch a URL and turn it into readable text.

servers.name: git
servers.description: Inspect and search a local git repository.
servers.needs: pass the repository: ax mcp add git --arg --repository=/path/to/repo

servers.name: sqlite
servers.description: Query and inspect a SQLite database.
servers.needs: pass the database: ax mcp add sqlite --arg --db-path=/path/to/db.sqlite

servers.name: postgres
servers.description: Read-only SQL over a Postgres database.
servers.needs: pass the connection string: ax mcp add postgres --arg postgres://user:pass@host/db
